name: Echoes in the House
source:
Thunder pulls you from sleep. Four doors open to fragments of a life. At the end, one question remains: will you forgive, or be devoured by memory?

[From [url=https://abstractedvoices.itch.io/echoes-in-the-house]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
雷声将你从睡梦中惊醒。四扇门向生命的碎片敞开。最后，还有一个问题：你会原谅，还是被记忆吞噬？

[来自[url=https://abstractedvoices.itch.io/echoes-in-the-house]Itch.io[/url]]
